# Byte

> Byte is a curated talent fellowship that brings a small group of outstanding young individuals from Finland to San Francisco for one week of focused conversations with world-class founders and operators building the future with technology.

Byte selects a small group of highly driven, ambitious individuals under 25 who are Finnish citizens or permanent residents. Participants are chosen for their technical ability, drive, and ambition — not prior experience. The format is intentionally small so every meeting is personal and high-signal for both sides.

Byte 3 takes place in autumn 2026. Applications were open 7–21 September 2026 and are now closed; nine fellows were selected. The week in San Francisco runs 26 October – 1 November 2026. All expenses covered.

Participation is free. Travel and accommodation are covered by the Technology Industries of Finland Centennial Foundation (Teknologiateollisuuden 100-vuotissäätiö).

Contact: guidebyte@gmail.com
